title: Sparse symmetric generalized inverses for sparse symmetric matrices
summary: Generalized inverses play a fundamental role in numerical linear algebra, particularly when matrices are rectangular, singular, or rank deficient. Even when the input matrix is sparse, generalized inverses such as the M-P pseudoinverse are typically dense, leading to high storage requirements, expensive matrix-vector multiplications, and reduced efficiency. We investigate computing sparse symmetric generalized inverses for sparse symmetric matrices, extending previous work on sparse generalized inverses for rectangular rank-deficient matrices.
